spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶1:** The emanation of truth that proceeds from the Divine will and is received into the understanding: interior affection elevates it from within, the faculty of articulate thought extends it into distinct forms, the power of natural discernment separ ates it into its particulars, and the outermost containment of the sens ory mind gathers it into final unity. Truth proceeds through the operation of these five successive degrees and becomes perceptible to the external mind.

**¶2:** So it is with truth formed into communicable knowledge: at the first degree it is poured forth from its interior source in love; at the second it is consolidated and made firm through the understanding ; at the third it is refined, turned upon itself, and shaped to its proper proportion ; at the fourth the authentic character of its origin is impressed upon it; and at the fifth it is purified and made clear. These five operations of the Divine order shape and perfect each communic able truth, and it enters the common understanding of humanity. It becomes a spiritual possession — truth that can be received into the mind and given forth to others.

** ¶3:** This is the nature of all truth: it is formed and perfected through five successive degrees of spiritual order. It proceeds forth from its source and is received into the understanding of those who stand without .

---

*Note : The " five " here res ists reduction to a single correspondence . It likely sign ifies the complet eness or suff iciency of discrete degrees through which what is most interior must pass before it can exist in an ou termost form capable of being communicated — the full desc ending series from will to ultim ation .*
